name: setup
title_zh: 新程序员进 Chops 仓库，先跑通构建再谈架构
tagline_zh: 别再让新人对着 README 猜：装什么、怎么跑、代码往哪放。这份 skill 把前置依赖、构建命令。
tagline_en: Stop making new hires guess from the README. This skill lays out prerequisites, build steps, codebase map, and.
desc_en: Get a new developer up and running with the Chops codebase — prerequisites, build, architecture, and common tasks.
why_zh: 它把「上手」拆成可勾选的清单，而非一段散文。每步都有明确产出，新人能自己确认进度，不用反复打断你。
why_en: It turns onboarding into a checklist with visible outputs, not a wall of prose. New devs self-report progress instead of pinging.
limit_zh: 只认 Shpigford/chops 这一个代码库，换仓库立刻失效。不含代码规范、测试写法或部署流程。
limit_en: Only for the Shpigford/chops repo. No coding standards, tests, or deploy steps — just getting from zero to a working build.
title_en: Onboard a new dev to the Chops repo: deps, build, map, tasks
